description_en: Modifies the statistical charts of a security report
description_zh: 修改安全报告统计图表
name: OperationCustomizeReportChart

parameters.help_en:
The report ID.
Call [DescribeCustomizeReportList](~~DescribeCustomizeReportList~~) to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
报告ID。
调用[DescribeCustomizeReportList](~~DescribeCustomizeReportList~~)可以获取该参数
parameters.name: report_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of report chart configurations. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
Call [DescribeChartList](~~DescribeChartList~~) to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
报告图表配置ID，多项用逗号分隔。
调用[DescribeChartList](~~DescribeChartList~~)可以获取该参数
parameters.name: chart_ids

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each API request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
